links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses (FRE, FKGL) relative to patient reading level
links.effect: Median FRE 18 (IQR 21) and median FKGL 15.8 (IQR 3), a college graduate reading level.
links.quote: The ChatGPT responses demonstrated a college graduate reading level, as indicated by the median FRE score of 18 (IQR = 21) and the median FKGL score of 15.8 (IQR = 3).

links.outcome: Appropriateness of ChatGPT responses for emergency urology cases
links.effect: Only 11.1% of emergency urology case responses were appropriate, versus 58.5% non-oncology and 52.6% oncology (p = 0.03).
links.quote: ChatGPT provided more appropriate responses for non-oncology conditions (58.5%) compared to oncology (52.6%) and emergency urology cases (11.1%) (p = 0.03).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's responses to 100 urology case studies for appropriateness, quality (DISCERN), and readability without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
